apps.name: OmniSalub
apps.summary: The record a clinic keeps about you — readings, history, what to raise next visit — kept on your phone instead of behind a portal login. Walk into the appointment prepared rather than trying to remember.
apps.detail: OmniSalub is a place to keep the readings you take, the history you already know, and the questions worth raising next time. It runs on your device. It does not connect you to a clinic and it does not speak for a clinician.
apps.hard_line: OmniSalub does not diagnose, treat, or replace a clinician. It keeps your own record so you can walk into an appointment prepared.
apps.meta_description: OmniSalub keeps readings, history and visit questions on your device. In development. Not a diagnosis, not a clinic, not a substitute for a clinician.

apps.name: OmniDent
apps.summary: The daily habits a hygienist actually asks about, tracked simply — with your own photo history over time, and the questions worth raising at the next appointment.
apps.detail: OmniDent is a household record: the routine, the photographs you chose to keep, and the questions for the next visit. It has no FDA authorization. Do not act on chat or photo-note text. Ask a dentist.
apps.hard_line: OmniDent is not a substitute for a dentist, and it has no FDA authorization. Do not act on chat or photo-note text — ask a dentist.
apps.meta_description: OmniDent tracks daily dental habits, a photo journal and visit questions on your device. In development. Not a substitute for a dentist.

apps.name: OmniDerm
apps.summary: A private journal for your skin. Photograph the same spot across months and keep the series together, in your own words. The app records what you noticed — it never tells you what it is.
apps.detail: OmniDerm is a journal you keep: photographs of the same spot, notes in your own words, and a record you can take to an appointment. It does not name a mark and it does not tell you whether to see a clinician.
apps.hard_line: OmniDerm never tells you what a mark is. It records what you noticed — photographs and your own notes — so you can keep a private series over time.
apps.meta_description: OmniDerm is a private skin journal: your photographs, your notes, over time. In development. It never tells you what a mark is.

apps.name: OmniRx
apps.summary: What a class of medicine is for, in plain language drawn from published labelling — plus a simple daily check and refill dates, so you reach the pharmacy counter knowing what to ask.
apps.detail: OmniRx explains published labelling in ordinary language and lets you keep a simple daily check and refill dates. It does not take the place of a pharmacist or a prescriber.
apps.hard_line: OmniRx is not medical advice. It does not diagnose, calculate doses, check interactions, or identify medicines from photographs.
apps.meta_description: OmniRx explains published medicine labelling in plain language and keeps a daily check and refill dates on your device. In development. Not medical advice.

apps.name: OmniLex
apps.audience: For people facing a legal process
apps.summary: The text of the law already belongs to everyone — it is simply unreadable. OmniLex puts public legal codes into plain language with every passage cited, so you arrive at a consultation already knowing the shape of your question.
apps.detail: OmniLex is a way to read public legal text with the citation attached. It is preparation for a conversation with a lawyer, not a substitute for one.
apps.hard_line: OmniLex does not represent you, give legal advice, or file anything on your behalf. It puts public legal codes into plain language with every passage cited.
apps.meta_description: OmniLex puts public legal codes into plain language with citations, on your device. In development. It does not represent you.

apps.name: OmniBuild
apps.summary: Building means permits, utility connections, inspections and trades — a maze that is mostly procedure, not expertise. OmniBuild maps what applies to your project, with the public standards cited, and is clear about which parts genuinely need a licensed professional.
apps.detail: OmniBuild is a map of procedure: permits, utilities, inspections, trades, and the public standards that sit behind them. Where a licence is required, it says so.
apps.hard_line: OmniBuild is not contracting, engineering, architectural, or code-compliance advice, and it is not a substitute for a licensed professional.
apps.meta_description: OmniBuild maps permits, utilities and public construction standards, and is clear where a licensed professional is required. In development.

apps.name: OmniWealth
apps.audience: For people learning how money works
apps.summary: How money concepts actually work, explained with sources you can check, plus tools to run your own numbers. It never recommends a product or an allocation — that isn't the gap it fills.
apps.detail: OmniWealth is a cited library of how money concepts work, and a place to run numbers you type yourself. It has no bank or brokerage connection, and it does not pick a product for you.
apps.hard_line: OmniWealth never recommends a product or an allocation, and it never connects to a bank.
apps.meta_description: OmniWealth explains money concepts with sources and lets you run your own numbers. In development. No product recommendation. No bank connection.

apps.name: OmniMath
apps.summary: Twenty-one chapters that build on each other, a cross-linked codex of concepts, and worked proofs that never skip a line. What a good tutor really gives you is the step that was left out — so none are.
apps.detail: OmniMath (published as OmniMathematics) is a course you can work through without a network: chapters in order, a codex of concepts, and proofs that keep every step on the page.
apps.hard_line: OmniMath is a course, not a credential and not a tutor who can certify you.
apps.meta_description: OmniMath is twenty-one chapters, a concept codex and worked proofs that never skip a line. Published as OmniMathematics. In development. Works offline.

apps.name: OmniAero
apps.summary: Ground school built around the FAA's own Airman Certification Standards — the twelve areas of operation, each broken into what you must know, what can go wrong, and what you must do. The regulation itself is always one tap away.
apps.detail: OmniAero is ACS ground school on this device: the areas of operation, the knowledge, the risks, the procedures, and the text of 14 CFR in language you can actually read. It does not fly the aeroplane and it does not sign a logbook.
apps.hard_line: OmniAero is ground school on this device. It is not flight instruction, not an endorsement, and not a substitute for a certified flight instructor or an examiner.
apps.meta_description: OmniAero is ACS ground school on your device, with 14 CFR one tap away. In development. Not flight instruction and not an endorsement.

apps.name: OmniPhysics
apps.summary: Physics you can experiment with rather than only read. Change a value in the sandbox and watch what it does — then follow the reasoning, step by step, from mechanics through to modern physics.
apps.detail: OmniPhysics is a sandbox and a set of worked explanations. You change a value, you watch what happens, and you can follow the reasoning that sits under it.
apps.hard_line: OmniPhysics is an educational sandbox. It does not replace a laboratory, a degree, or an instructor.
apps.meta_description: OmniPhysics is an interactive physics sandbox with worked reasoning, on your device. In development. Not a substitute for a laboratory or an instructor.
